newFindings.symptom: the last shot of a qualification position is cleared from the target face too quickly to inspect
newFindings.rootCause: ShootingPage.qml enterPositionTransition() clears globalModelOfData and repopulates it with only the new position's sighters; triggered by the positionWatch 500 ms poll at official shot 20 and 40. The ~1.8 s observed is paper-feed duration plus one poll interval - incidental, not designed.
newFindings.competitionImpact: NONE - state, clock, target mode, persistence and feed all correct
newFindings.recommendation: 2.5 s presentation-only hold of the last marker and score, with a POSITION COMPLETE caption

newFindings.symptom: END OF PREPARATION AND SIGHTING...STOP is announced ~138 ms AFTER MATCH FIRING...START
newFindings.rule: 6.11.1.1 j then 6.11.1.2 a - STOP, ~30 s pause, then MATCH FIRING

newFindings.symptom: MATCH FIRING...START is announced again at each position change (3 times per session)
newFindings.rule: 6.11.1.2 a - one MATCH FIRING...START per match
